about_the_game:
STORY

You arrive at an abandoned house, not as a guest — but as an investigator of the occult.
Whispers of an ancient ritual still echo through its halls. Every room breathes guilt, sorrow, and the remnants of those who once lived within.
A mother’s despair, a father’s obsession, a child’s lost innocence… their shadows still linger.

As the boundaries between reality and nightmare blur, you begin to question your own sanity.
Are you here to end the curse — or become part of it?

GAMEPLAY

  • First-person psychological horror experience built around fear, observation, and atmosphere.

  • Hallucination transitions that shift the world around you — one moment you’re in a quiet living room, the next you’re trapped in a decaying asylum.

  • Environmental storytelling and puzzles that reveal the tragic history behind each room.

  • No weapons, no safety — only your instincts to guide you through the dark.

MATURE CONTENT DESCRIPTION

This game contains intense horror elements, scenes of psychological distress, and depictions of violence.

Themes of death, trauma, and family abuse are present throughout the story.

Some content may not be suitable for all audiences. Player discretion is advised.

name: Witchblood
short_description: Witchblood is a first-person psychological horror game that drags players into the heart of a dark curse. Explore a decaying house where hallucinations and reality intertwine. Uncover the truth behind a forgotten family’s tragedy — observe, survive, and confront what should have stayed buried.
